name: Find Image Online
summary: Find and display an image inline using Wikipedia/Wikimedia. Extract the real upload URL from the page HTML.

steps.note: Search '<subject> wikipedia' to get the Wikipedia article URL
Fetch the Wikipedia article page. The HTML will contain upload.wikimedia.org image URLs.

Scan fetched HTML for the FIRST URL matching: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/[a-f0-9]/[a-f0-9][a-f0-9]/<filename>/<width>px-<filename>. Use the thumbnail URL as-is — do NOT strip the /thumb/ path or the size suffix. These URLs work. URLs without /thumb/ often 404.
Output exactly: ![<subject>](https://upload.wikimedia.org/...the-thumb-url...) — this renders inline. If no URL found, try web_search for 'site:upload.wikimedia.org <subject>'.

notes: CRITICAL: Use /thumb/ URLs from Wikipedia HTML — they always work. Direct /wikipedia/commons/ URLs without /thumb/ return 404.
NEVER fetch pexels.com, unsplash.com, pixabay.com, shutterstock.com — 403 bots
NEVER try to construct Wikimedia URLs manually — extract them from the fetched page HTML
Render as markdown: ![alt](url) — the chat client renders this inline
If Wikipedia has no image, try web_search for 'commons.wikimedia.org <subject>' then fetch that commons page
